description: Wire REQUIRETLS inbound handling into crates/smtp/src/session.rs. When MAIL FROM with REQUIRETLS parameter arrives: (1) if session is not TLS, reject with '530 5.7.0 Must issue STARTTLS first'; (2) store requiretls=true in session state; (3) on DATA completion, tag the incoming message in the database with requires_tls=true; (4) if stoa is a relay and needs to forward the message, propagate REQUIRETLS on the onward SMTP delivery. NOTE: this bead is BLOCKED by stoa-ryw.3 (STARTTLS not yet implemented). File the dep. Implement the session logic and tagging; outbound propagation can be gated on stoa-ryw.3 being closed.
title: Wire REQUIRETLS into SMTP inbound session lifecycle
